To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the B -> pi^0pi^0 puzzle is not yet resolved, and that the B -> rhorrho puzzle is resolved, at least in the NLO PQCD and the QCD-improvised factorization approaches.
the B -> pi and B -> rho data do not support the large NLO corrections to the B -> pi form factors, and the B -> rho data are in favor of the factorization approach for the B -> rho form factors.

the B -> pi K data have excluded the possibility of resolving B -> pi pi from the large observed branching ratio of B^0 ->pi^0 pi^ 0 in both PQCD and QCDF approaches, and that a sizable direct CP asymmetry in B^0 ->rho^0 pi^+ pi^- is predicted in PQCD.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the B^0 and B^+ -> rho^0 pi^+, rho^0 pi^- branching ratios.
the B -> pi K and B -> rho pi decays, which have been studied by many authors, but have not been fully understood.
the implications of the B -> rho^0 pi^+ and B -> rho^+ pi^- data on the B -> pi^+ pi^- puzzle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the large B^0 ->pi^0 pi^ 0 branching ratio is not a puzzle at the present stage.
all the available approaches are not able to resolve the B -> pi^0 pie^0 puzzle, and that more experimental and theoretical inputs are needed to resolve the puzzle.
, at present, the B -> pi^0pi^0 puzzle cannot be explained in the framework of the standard model, and the new physics effects are necessary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the data for the B -> rho^0 K^0, rho^0 rho^\mp, and pi^\pm K^\mp modes have strongly constrained the possible resolution to the B -> pi^0 rho^+, pi^0 pi^\pm puzzles, and the B -> pi^\mp rho^\mp puzzle, and that the data for all these channels can be well accommodated by the PQCD approach.
the B -> pi and B -> rho data have strongly constrained the possible resolution to the B -> pi puzzle, and the B -> pi data are more restrictive.
the B -> pi and B -> rho transitions should have the same underlying mechanism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the B -> pi and B -> rho data have put a strong constraint on any approach that tries to resolve the B -> pi puzzle from the B^0-> pi^0 pi ^0 data.
the B -> pi K puzzle is unlikely to be resolved by the B -> rho pi data.
the B^0 \to \pi^0 \pi^0 data are not compatible with the large B^0 \rightarrow \pi^0\pi^0 rate observed in the B^0\to\rho^0\rho^0 data.
